metadata.title: Public Health Analytics-OS programme and system/portal discovery facets

definitions.programme: A policy, service-delivery or disease-control programme or programme family.
definitions.systemPortal: An information system, reporting platform, registry or portal used to capture, exchange or publish programme information.
definitions.source: The cited authority, publication, catalogue or dataset from which the record metadata is derived.

rules: A source label is not automatically a programme label.
HMIS is classified as a system/portal facet and excluded from the programme facet.
Survey and publication families remain discoverable through Source rather than being presented as programmes.
One indicator may belong to several programmes and use several systems or portals.
System/portal mappings require an explicit textual reference in a governed evidence field.
Absence of a system/portal tag means not specified in the currently mapped metadata, not that no system exists.
The system/portal facet does not assert operational field-level interoperability.
